gameCameraPreview.why: static_prop_candidate.py renders only ortho views; its game-3q-55deg shot is orthographic. This script renders the delivered FBX with a perspective camera, horizontal FOV 35 (UE convention), pitch -55, yaw 0/45, plus ortho front/side, 1200x900 JPEG, material rebuilt from the BC/N/ORM triplet (N DirectX flipped back to OpenGL, so a wrong normal convention shows as inverted relief)
gameCameraPreview.axes: The FBX is read back in UE axes: asset front = +X (UM_FBX_v1 turns .blend -Y into +X). Looking at the front, frame-left = -Y and frame-right = +Y in the readback. Verified on the barrel: bung faces the +X camera, moves to frame-left at yaw +45
